## High Level Overview of Change

Title pretty much says it all. This is a one-line change to mark the `featureSmartEscrow` amendment as `Supported::yes`. This PR should not be merged until the rest of the Smart Escrow PRs are merged.

### Context of Change

The purpose of this PR is to make it easier for those running the amendment locally or deploying it to a devnet, so they do not need to change the source code themselves to do so. 

Stack of PRs (from `develop` outwards):

* https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/pull/5810
* https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/pull/6329
* This PR

N/A

reviewCommentsList.author: Copilot
reviewCommentsList.body: FeeSetup gained SmartEscrow-related fields, but FeeSetup::toFees() still constructs Fees using only {reference_fee, account_reserve, owner_reserve}. As a result, extension_compute_limit/extension_size_limit/gas_price from config will not propagate into the Fees used for Ledger construction (and will remain 0), which is inconsistent with the new config options. Update the conversion path (e.g., extend Fees construction/assignment) so these new values are carried through when featureSmartEscrow is enabled.

reviewCommentsList.author: Copilot
reviewCommentsList.body:
MICRO_DROPS_PER_DROP is defined in a header as a non-inline namespace-scope constexpr while the adjacent constant uses inline constexpr. Consider making this inline constexpr as well to match the established pattern and avoid potential unused-const-variable warnings across translation units.
```suggestion
inline constexpr std::uint32_t MICRO_DROPS_PER_DROP{1'000'000};
```

reviewCommentsList.author: Copilot
reviewCommentsList.body: This subscription JSON field check covers extension_compute/extension_size when featureSmartEscrow is enabled/disabled, but it never asserts the presence/absence of gas_price even though NetworkOPs now publishes it alongside the other SmartEscrow fee fields. Add equivalent checks for jss::gas_price in both branches so the test matches the updated API behavior.

reviewCommentsList.author: Copilot
reviewCommentsList.body:
The gas_price documentation here appears inconsistent: the placeholder says "<bytes>" and the description talks about drops, but the code/config comments define gas_price in micro-drops (see FeeSetup::gas_price) and Fees.h introduces MICRO_DROPS_PER_DROP. Please correct the placeholder/unit wording so operators know what value to configure (and ensure the example value corresponds to the stated unit).
```suggestion
#   gas_price = <micro_drops>
#
#       The gas price is the conversion between WASM gas and its price in
#       micro-drops.
#
#       If this parameter is unspecified, xrpld will use an internal
#       default. Don't change this without understanding the consequences.
#
#       Example:
#           gas_price = 1000000      # 1 drop (1,000,000 micro-drops) per gas
```

reviewCommentsList.author: depthfirst-app[bot]
reviewCommentsList.body:
🟡 **Severity: MEDIUM**

Gas/bytecode/price `VotableValue` objects are always created (line 214-225) with non-zero config targets (defaults: gas_limit=1M, bytecode_size_limit=100K, gas_price=1M) vs current ledger value of 0 when SmartEscrow is disabled. Since no votes are collected when the amendment is off, `getVotes()` returns `(target, true)`, causing this condition to be true and triggering unnecessary fee pseudo-transactions every flag ledger on every default-configured validator.
Helpful? Add 👍 / 👎

<details>
<summary>💡 Fix Suggestion</summary>

**Suggestion:** Guard the gas/bytecode/price vote conditions with a `rules.enabled(featureSmartEscrow)` check so that when the SmartEscrow amendment is disabled, the gas-related `VotableValue` results (which will always show a change due to non-zero targets vs zero current values) do not trigger an unnecessary fee pseudo-transaction. Replace the condition at lines 344-345 to wrap the gas-related checks:

```cpp
    if (baseFee.second || baseReserve.second || incReserve.second ||
        (rules.enabled(featureSmartEscrow) &&
         (gasLimit.second || bytecodeSizeLimit.second || gasPrice.second)))
```

This ensures the gas/bytecode/price vote differences only contribute to triggering a fee transaction when the SmartEscrow amendment is actually enabled.

> **⚠️ Experimental Feature**: This code suggestion is automatically generated. Please review carefully.

```suggestion
    if (baseFee.second || baseReserve.second || incReserve.second ||
        (rules.enabled(featureSmartEscrow) &&
         (gasLimit.second || bytecodeSizeLimit.second || gasPrice.second)))
```

</details>
